issues.description: Basic usage example uses gratuitous next() over a generator instead of simple indexing
issues.detail: `training_node = next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` is needlessly clever and teaches a bad pattern. Use `pipeline.nodes[0]` or an explicit name lookup. The generator expression suggests filtering that isn't happening. Copy-pasted into user code this becomes cargo cult.

issues.description: ImagePreview example has unreachable/dead return masquerading as alternative
issues.detail: The function returns the URL form, then has a commented-out data URI return below it. A reader skimming sees two returns; one is dead. Split into two named example functions or use a parameter on the function. Don't teach readers to leave dead returns in their code.

issues.description: CustomPreview example uses `[...]` Ellipsis literals that mislead and won't run cleanly
issues.detail: `"nodes": [...]` and `"edges": [...]` are Python-legal but semantically misleading in a tutorial and will produce Ellipsis on JSON serialization. Show one concrete element or use `[]` with a comment like `# list of node dicts`. Documentation examples should be copy-paste correct or visibly incomplete.

issues.description: Preview type contract is documented only by example; no written supertype spec
issues.detail: The docs introduce JsonPreview, TablePreview, PlotlyPreview, MermaidPreview, ImagePreview, TextPreview, and CustomPreview but never state the supertype contract: required fields, per-subtype content preconditions, to_dict() guarantees, or what node.preview() may raise. Add a Preview ADT section stating preconditions, postconditions, and invariants before the per-type sections.

issues.description: preview_fn signature, error semantics, and meta/renderer_key contracts are unspecified
issues.detail: Docs never state preview_fn's required signature, whether async is allowed, what node.preview() returns when preview_fn is absent, or how exceptions propagate. meta is overloaded as both opaque metadata and renderer config (Mermaid layout, code language), and CustomPreview's renderer_key leaks a Kedro-Viz frontend dependency with no ownership or failure modes specified. Pin these contracts before leaving experimental.

issues.description: Standalone node() snippets lack imports, pipeline wrapping, and reference undefined functions
issues.detail: Mermaid and Text preview sections show bare `node(...)` calls outside any `Pipeline([...])`, omit `from kedro.pipeline import node`, and reference undefined functions like `process_data` and `calculate_metrics`. A reader copying these gets NameError or an orphan node. Either wrap in a Pipeline block matching Basic Usage or mark snippets as fragments.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the PR is a useful documentation patch for the experimental preview_fn feature, but the example code has consistent small sloppiness that propagates poorly: a gratuitous next()-over-generator, dead-code returns, Ellipsis literals as placeholders, and snippets divorced from any runnable pipeline context. Beyond surface issues, the docs describe behavior by example rather than stating the abstract Preview contract — supertype shape, per-subtype preconditions, preview_fn signature and error semantics, and the meta/renderer_key boundary with Kedro-Viz are all undefined. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK. Fix the examples so they run as written and add a written contract section before this leaves experimental.
